title: Tesla Optimus Gen 4 Begins Consumer Home Deliveries at $20K
description: Tesla starts delivering Optimus Gen 4 humanoid robots to consumers at $20,000. The robot handles laundry, cooking, and cleaning with 99.2% reliability in home environments.

title: Figure 03 Humanoids Deployed in 500+ Factories with 99.95% Uptime
description: Figure AI deploys 5,000+ Figure 03 humanoid robots across 500+ factories globally, handling complex assembly tasks with human-level dexterity and near-perfect uptime.

title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Gen 3 Fully Autonomous in Construction Sites
description: Fully electric Atlas Gen 3 robots now operate autonomously on construction sites, handling material transport, site inspection, and safety monitoring without human supervision.

title: Toyota T-HR5 Humanoid Achieves Full Automotive Assembly Autonomy
description: Toyota's T-HR5 humanoid robot now performs complete automotive assembly line tasks autonomously, 70% faster than human workers with zero defects in pilot production.

title: Unitree H3 Sets Marathon Record: 42km Continuous Humanoid Running
description: Chinese robotics company Unitree demonstrates H3 humanoid completing a full marathon distance at 10 m/s, setting new endurance and speed records for bipedal robots.

title: Sanctuary AI Phoenix Gen 10 Achieves Full Hand Autonomy
description: Phoenix Gen 10 demonstrates complete hand autonomy with sub-millimeter precision in manipulation tasks. 100+ deployment sites across manufacturing and healthcare.

title: 1X Technologies NEO Begins Mass Home Robot Production
description: 1X Technologies scales NEO home humanoid to mass production with 10,000 units planned for 2026. Expanded home testing program now includes 1,000 families across 15 countries.

title: Waymo Surpasses 100 Million Autonomous Rides, Expands to 20 Cities
description: Waymo reaches 100M autonomous rides with 200K+ daily trips across 20 cities globally. New markets include Tokyo, London, and Sydney with zero at-fault accidents.

title: Autonomous Surgical Robot Performs First Unassisted Brain Surgery
description: Medical robotics breakthrough as autonomous surgical system successfully completes complex brain tumor removal with sub-millimeter precision and zero complications.

title: Agility Robotics Digit Reaches 500+ Retail Store Deployments
description: Agility's Digit humanoid robots now operating in 500+ retail locations handling inventory management, restocking, and customer service with full autonomy.

title: China's Humanoid Robot Market Reaches $50B with 500+ Startups
description: China's embodied AI push results in 500+ humanoid robotics startups with combined $50B funding in 2026. Government mandates humanoid deployment in all state factories by 2027.

title: AI Exoskeletons Reach 200K Units Deployed for Industrial Workers
description: AI-powered exoskeletons reach 200,000 deployed units globally, reducing workplace injuries by 85% in manufacturing, logistics, and construction sectors.
